== Summary ==
Slip “•Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice (V)” cut unchanged from page 4 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF file created 13 October 2026), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 790, 581, 1166)). Version [[Do, Or Do Not & •Wise Advice (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
